name: FVM Manager
description: Control FVM (Flutter Version Manager) from Orca's sidebar: see the Flutter SDK pinned by the focused workspace, switch it with fvm use, install, remove and set the global SDK.

settings.title: FVM executable
settings.description: Leave empty to find fvm on PATH. Set a full path if Orca can't find it (for example /opt/homebrew/bin/fvm).
